sources.entry: Google Magenta - AI and music research project.

summary.name: Magenta
summary.one_liner: Magenta is a research project from Google exploring machine learning in the creation of art and music, offering open-source music tools, DAW plugins and models.
use_cases: generate music ideas with AI inside a DAW
morph audio between instruments in realtime
explore and curate piano samples from a transformer model
summary.what_it_does: Magenta is a Google research project exploring how machine learning can be used in creating art and music. The page lists featured projects: Magenta Studio, a set of music plugins for Ableton Live built on Magenta's open-source tools and models, also downloadable as standalone native apps; DDSP-VST, a DAW plugin that morphs audio from one instrument to another in realtime and is playable with MIDI; The Infinite Crate, a DAW plugin prototype integrating the Lyria RealTime API, now open-sourced under Apache 2.0; and Listen to Transformer, an app for exploring and curating samples from a piano transformer. It also highlights Magenta RealTime 2, an open-source framework with open-weights live music model for real-time interactive apps, and Lyria Camera, which generates a musical score from camera input using Gemini image understanding and Lyria RealTime.
notable: Magenta RealTime 2 open-weights live music model and framework
DDSP-VST realtime instrument timbre morphing, MIDI playable
The Infinite Crate open-sourced under Apache 2.0 for forking
Magenta Studio runs as standalone native apps without extra dependencies
caveats: Pricing not stated on the page
The Infinite Crate is described as a prototype
